programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada & What's On Today
programme.desc: This legal mystery follows three trauma-scarred legal elites—a criminal defense lawyer with a troubled past, a senior judge grieving his murdered family, and a charismatic prosecutor who manipulates the law.

programme.title: Seoul follow me!
programme.desc: In this TVB travel show, popular host Helen To shifts her focus from Japan to Seoul, South Korea. To test the online hype, she personally tries out viral travel itineraries, trending restaurants, cafes, photo spots, and shopping challenges to see if these social media trends are actually worth visiting.

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Neighborhood Treasures (Sr.7)
programme.desc: Sammy and Kitty, this quirky duo, reunite on screen, this time as secret agent leaders, delivering hilarious clips from Taiwan, Japan, and Hong Kong to the audience. Each episode features celebrity guests divided into two teams, each using their imagination to solve incredibly difficult puzzles related to the hilarious clips alongside the leader. They can also ask two beautiful "fun agents" for hints, but they'll have to judge for themselves which information is true and which is false. The worst-performing guest will receive "retraining" from the leader—what punishment awaits the guests?

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: TVB 59th Anniversary Gala (Live)
programme.desc: This live sports coverage brings viewers straight to Macau's legendary, high-speed Guia Circuit a grueling and narrow temporary street circuit renowned worldwide for its tight bends, steep climbs, and zero-margin-for-error barriers.

programme.title: The Trembling of Cicada
programme.desc: This legal mystery follows three trauma-scarred legal elites—a criminal defense lawyer with a troubled past, a senior judge grieving his murdered family, and a charismatic prosecutor who manipulates the law.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Life On The Line
programme.desc: Ever since his wife CHEUNG WAI-SUM (Ali Lee) was killed by a drunk driver, Principal Ambulanceman MAK CHAY-TIN (Joe Ma) has been living together with his only daughter LOK-YEE, older sister OI-FA (Pinky Cheung) and sister-in-law CHEUNG HO-KEI (Moon Lau). The loss of his wife makes CHAY-TIN hate those rule-breakers and any reckless behaviors. At work, he is stern about everything! His new subordinate CHEUK KA-KIT (Matthew Ho) acts on impulse, and conflict often ensues as a result. Moreover, as a perfectionist, their new superior Probationary Ambulance Officer TAM KA-CHUN (Joey Law) constantly picks on KA-KIT, adding extra pressure to their teammates. Caught in the middle, CHAY-TIN works relentlessly to bridge the differences between them in an effort to promote a spirit of teamwork, cultivating an elite rescue unit to save more lives when facing a variety of challenges……

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

programme.title: Last Breakthrough, The
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins “Life Force”, an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up “Lung Shing Medical Centre” to help the poor. When FUN is working with the organization in Kenya, he meets a young doctor called CHAI PAK HANG (LAM, RAYMOND), who works at a private hospital named “Ling Siu” in Hong Kong. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins “Lung Shing” later. HONG KIU (KWOK, SONIJA), a nurse at “Ling Siu”, is impressed by FUN by his principle of putting patients first. However, FUN cannot get over TUNG. Meanwhile, HANG meets a volunteer HA HIU CHING (TONG, LEILA) when he is in Africa and likes her very much. When they meet at “Lung Shing” again, CHING hangs back because of the existence of KO SIU YAU (CHAN MAN CHI, SHARON), who comes from a wealthy family. Working with FUN at both “Lung Shing” and “Life Force”, HANG learns that apart from giving patients medical treatments, doctors should also help patients to live a meaningful life. However, when HANG and FUN face their own lifetime challenges, they feel weak and helpless.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Gui Dui
programme.desc: Set during the war against Japanese aggression, the drama follows a small squad from the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army after they lose contact with the main army following a heavy siege by Japanese forces.The story uses a four-line narrative to track the different paths of the scattered soldiers—led by Platoon Leader Lu Changshan and Squad Leader Tang Deyuan—as they navigate various struggles, including labor camps and bandit hideouts. Despite being separated and facing distinct life fates, their ultimate goal remains the same: to survive, fight back, and regroup.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Eva's mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mother's wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Eva's heart?

programme.title: She’s Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks “Jiang Yuan Nong”. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyone's fate.

programme.title: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: A group of bounty hunters, including San, Yo, Cat, Swan and Bobo, are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings that have plagued an international hotel group. Unfortunately, Swan, Cat and Bobo are kidnapped by the mastermind of the bombings. Can San and Yo save them? Will the bounty hunters accomplish their mission?

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer knows his father Wah is intellectually challenged since young and has to take care of him after his mother left them. When Mancer discovers and finds solace in stand-up comedy, he learns that hardships provide the best comedic material - from his own school ridicule experience to pandemic woes, misery can fuel laughter!

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: This film celebrates the 25th anniversary of Hong Kong's Handover in a series of four cultural stories about young Hong Kongers from different walks of life: a young man with autism pursuing his dream, a reconciliation between father and son, a Chinese opera star helping young pop singers, and a Nepali youth becoming a professional lion dancer.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai becomes the prime suspect in a police murder case. He takes hostages at the police station and demands to negotiate with former negotiator Jun. As the two engage in a high-stake battle of wits, their expertise in psychological manipulation leads to a tense verbal sparring match, gradually shifting their positions and mind sets.

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates the death of Yan Zhen in an explosion which seems more than an accident to him. Wei then finds out that Yan Zhen looks a lot like Yin, the girlfriend of Yan Zhen's childhood friend Lu, and uncovers a tangled web of deceit leading to surprising revelations when he merges details from the past and the present.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin…

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world…

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the director/writer's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: Ace
programme.desc: Kannan moves to a foreign country seeking life, but gets dragged into shark circle. A heist turns hope into a curse, forcing him to outsmart fate.
